doc.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Gordon and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well listen I appreciate your spending this time with me.
And I really hope for the best for your career and your composing especially. I love to hear that you’re writing new music, that people are doing that out there, because it really lasts.
Okay. I’ll make sure that I get your card or whatever now, I’ll send you some.
All right, appreciate it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
